security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown backticks or a safe development-only NODE_ENV check. The guide does ask users to install packages and configure an MCP server, so those command and agent-configuration risks remain confirmed.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running npm install, npx add-mcp, agentation-mcp init, or agentation-mcp doctor. Pin package versions where possible.

remediation.issue: MCP server registration expands agent tool access
remediation.suggestion: Document what data the MCP server reads and syncs, keep it local to development, and ask users to review configuration before restarting agents.

content.value_statement: Teams need a quick way to add visual feedback to Next.js development. This skill installs Agentation, wires the toolbar, and explains optional MCP syncing.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether Agentation is already listed in project dependencies.
Installs Agentation with the detected package manager when missing.
Detects Next.js App Router and Pages Router layouts.
Adds the Agentation toolbar only for development mode.
Explains optional MCP server setup for annotation syncing.
Lists verification guidance for the Agentation MCP server.
limitations: Designed for Next.js App Router and Pages Router projects.
Does not build custom annotation workflows beyond Agentation setup.
MCP setup still requires user review and agent restart.

use_cases.title: Add feedback capture to a Next.js app
use_cases.description: Set up Agentation during active frontend development and keep it out of production rendering.

use_cases.title: Connect visual review with AI agents
use_cases.description: Use annotations during implementation review and sync them to coding agents through optional MCP setup.

use_cases.title: Standardize project setup
use_cases.description: Check whether Agentation already exists, avoid duplicate setup, and apply the same integration steps across repositories.

prompt_templates.title: Add Agentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up Agentation in this Next.js project. Check if it is installed, add it only for development, and summarize changes.

prompt_templates.title: Detect Router First
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup when the project structure is unclear.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this project for App Router or Pages Router. Then add the Agentation toolbar in the correct root file.

prompt_templates.title: Include MCP Guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced setup for teams using AI coding agents.
prompt_templates.prompt: After configuring Agentation, explain the MCP setup options for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents. Do not run setup commands without confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Existing Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before changing an existing repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository for an existing Agentation integration, package dependency, and MCP setup notes. Report gaps and recommend minimal changes.

output_examples.input: Add Agentation to this App Router project.
output_examples.output: Agentation was added to the root layout and limited to development mode. The response also noted optional MCP setup and restart steps.

output_examples.input: Check whether this project already has Agentation.
output_examples.output: The skill reports whether the dependency and toolbar are already present, then exits without duplicate changes.

output_examples.input: Explain MCP setup for the toolbar.
output_examples.output: The skill describes universal setup, Claude Code setup, agent restart, default port, and available annotation syncing tools.

best_practices: Review dependency changes before installation commands run.
Keep the toolbar limited to development mode.
Restart the coding agent only after reviewing MCP server configuration.
anti_patterns: Do not run npx or MCP setup commands without user approval.
Do not add the toolbar to production rendering paths.
Do not duplicate Agentation when the project already has it.

faq.question: What does this skill add to a project?
faq.answer: It adds the Agentation visual feedback toolbar to a supported Next.js project.

faq.question: Which Next.js routing styles are supported?
faq.answer: It supports App Router and Pages Router root integration points.

faq.question: Does Agentation run in production?
faq.answer: The skill uses a development environment check so the toolbar loads only during development.

faq.question: Is MCP setup required?
faq.answer: No. MCP setup is optional and enables real-time annotation syncing with supported AI coding agents.

faq.question: Which AI tools are mentioned?
faq.answer: The setup guidance mentions Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and other supported agents.

faq.question: What should users review before running setup commands?
faq.answer: Users should review package installation, MCP server configuration, default port use, and any agent restart steps.
